hooks.command: command -v mien >/dev/null 2>&1 || { command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv tool install git+https://github.com/arinyaho/mien >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v mien >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'The mien CLI is not on PATH and could not be installed automatically. Install uv, then run: uv tool install git+https://github.com/arinyaho/mien'; }
